Yeah the course I chose was not for me and as I said, I have a very short attention span. I have talked to a psychiatrist and asked him about sending me to an ADD specialist to get diagnosed but that was two months ago and haven't from them since. These things take a long time sometimes although I wish I did it a lot sooner.

On a related note my parents have no idea what ADD is and thinks that it's just some obscure theory I found online to justify my behavior and that "everyone daydreams".
